sloka: मयि भावो हि वैदेह्याः तत्त्वतो विनिवेशितः ।मम अपि भावः सीतायाम् सर्वधा विनिवेशितः ॥४-१-५२॥
transliteration: mayi bhāvo hi vaidehyāḥ tattvato viniveśitaḥ ।mama api bhāvaḥ sītāyām sarvadhā viniveśitaḥ ॥4-1-52॥

translations.english: 'This cool breeze that carries the fragrance of flowers, that is gentle in its touch feels like fire when I think about my beautiful beloved.
